description: Find 10 local businesses on Google Maps for any search and place: name, category, address, phone, website, rating, review count and opening hours as JSON. Use it when: A task needs real local businesses, such as dentists in Leeds or coffee near Austin. Not for: Reading reviews in depth (use the Google reviews node) or looking up private people. Returns: 10 places: name, category, address, phone, website, rating, review count, coordinates, opening hours and a Maps link. Typical time: about 16 s. Price: $0.042 per search (up to 10 businesses), charged only on success. One call = up to 10 businesses.

location.description: City, area or address, e.g. Austin, Texas, USA

query.description: What to look for, e.g. coffee shop, dentist, plumber

name: maps-business-search
title: Google Maps business search
